prompt_text: Best all-in-one fundraising platform for nonprofits
response_text:
Several **all-in-one fundraising platforms** are recommended for nonprofits, each with distinct advantages:

**Givebutter** stands out as a top choice, offering 0% fees on donations with built-in rewards and a 2.5% APY on funds[2]. It provides comprehensive tools including payment forms, event ticketing, customized campaigns, live-stream fundraising, and donor management[9].

**Givesuite** is positioned as a comprehensive hub that consolidates all nonprofit operations under one flat-rate pricing model[1].

**Funraise** is an all-in-one platform featuring smart pop-up donation forms and fundraising website builders designed to help nonprofits hit their goals[4].

**Give Lively** offers a **free platform** for nonprofits with intuitive donor interfaces, including fundraising pages, text-to-donate, peer-to-peer fundraising, and event ticketing[5].

**Mightycause** also provides free nonprofit software, eliminating subscription costs while offering donation forms and donor CRM tools[10].

Other notable platforms mentioned include Neon CRM (which adds donor management, event management, and membership tracking)[6], Classy, Donorbox, and GoFundMe Pro[7][8].

The best choice depends on your nonprofit's specific needs—whether you prioritize zero fees, comprehensive features, or free tiers—and your budget constraints.
